title: Area (WebSocket list item)
description: Item of the WS 'areas' response: raw areas row plus entity_count, tags, *_src and icon_svg. Only active areas, filtered by client tags.

icon_svg.description: SVG path data resolved from an mdi: icon, rendered by the apps.

card_image_path.description: Server file path. Only in admin sessions (Ingress, admin web UI) and the admin REST API; never sent to paired apps. Use the *_src / *_url fields.

bg_light_path.description: Server file path. Only in admin sessions (Ingress, admin web UI) and the admin REST API; never sent to paired apps. Use the *_src / *_url fields.

bg_dark_path.description: Server file path. Only in admin sessions (Ingress, admin web UI) and the admin REST API; never sent to paired apps. Use the *_src / *_url fields.

grid_cols.description: DB default 2, REST response default 4, apps default 4 (known deviation D2, docs/protocol.md).

room_climate.description: Which entities give the room temperature and humidity of the area card, the climate capsule, the wall panel and widgets (room-climate.json, docs/room-climate.md). When absent, the apps apply the rule locally.
